senses.gloss: m. (v. עֲדֵי I, Pa.) carrying, going with child.
units: Gen. R. s. 20 הרונך זה צער הע׳ heronekh (Gen. III, 16) means the inconveniences during pregnancy, v. עִיבּוּר. Yalk. ib. 82 (ref. to עדנה, Gen. XVIII, 12) האשה … ע׳ ולדות as long as a woman is young, there is for her a possibility of bearing children; a. e.—Pl. עִידּוּיִין.

Gen. R. s. 48 (ed. Wil.) האשה הזאת כל זמן שהיא ילדה יש לה עִידּוּיִין וכ׳ as long as a woman is young, there is for her a possibility &c., and I, after I am grown old, should have ʿednah?—V. עִידּוֹן.
